incident_text: A building is burning and firefighters are working on it.

result.scene_summary: Firefighters are extinguishing a large fire engulfing a structure on a grassy slope, with thick black smoke billowing into the sky.

observations.description: Large plume of thick black smoke rising from the burning structure.
Bright orange flames visible through broken windows and on the side of the building.
Partial collapse and damage to the building's exterior, including broken windows and exposed framing.
A white fence visible in the foreground and a power line pole behind the firefighters.
Firefighters operating a hose from a fire truck, although the vehicle itself is mostly out of frame.
Three firefighters in gear standing on a grassy slope, operating a hose against the fire.
